heads.t: 交通8微罪「併排臨停、機車違停」取消檢舉！這5類違規仍可舉發 路上違規停車或騎車使用手機，許多民眾習慣以手機拍照檢舉，但自2024年6月30日起，根據《道路交通管理處罰條例》第7條之1修正，8類最高罰鍰1200元以下的交通微罪已排除民眾檢舉範圍，僅剩5類違規可檢舉。新制也規定違規記點僅適用於當場舉發案件，民眾檢舉、科技執法不再記點，檢舉資料需於7天內提出，並須清楚記錄違規事實。此舉明確劃分可檢舉項目，駕駛人違規仍須依法受罰，民眾檢舉需注意條件與期限。 12 分鐘前｜社會 交通8微罪「併排臨停、機車違停」取消檢舉！這5類違規仍可舉發 12 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: Traffic charges of eight micro-crimes, "Closed parking, broken parking" were cancelled. These five types of violations are still in place, and many people are used to taking pictures of them on their mobile phones, although since 30 June 2024, as amended by article 7 bis of the Road Traffic Administration Ordinance, eight of the maximum penalties for petty traffic offences of up to $1,200 have been excluded from public scrutiny, with only five of them remaining. The new system also regulates the use of non-compliance points only in the event of a case being filed on the spot, and public scrutiny, technical regulation, and disclosure data must be submitted within seven days and clearly documented. In this case, the driver must still be punished according to the law. 12 minutes ago, the public banned traffic for eight minor offences: "Standing over, car breaking." These five types of violations still take place.
